BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: How can I read at night without my parents knowing? ASSISTANT:

Reading at night without parent's knowledge is not advisable. It is better to ask for their permission and discuss why you would like to read at night. If reading at night is something that you really need to do, then you could try reading in dim light or using a reading lamp. You could also try reading during the daytime when your parents are not around.
